title: Comet Snake : second chance
brief: Playtesters love Comet Snake but rage-quit when one comet ends a long run. Give them one way to survive.

title: Comet Snake : big prize
brief: The score chase is flat. Give greedy players something rare and worth a detour.

title: Comet Snake : shortcut
brief: Long snakes take too long to cross the map. Give the player a way to jump across it.

title: Comet Snake : breather
brief: After a few speed-ups the comets feel relentless. Give the player a short moment to breathe.
